maintenance.change: Built: 6 variants and the specification page. Parity measured in the 18 contexts (forms-parity.plugin.js).

Anatomy board redrawn (user review of the Figma parity gate): the enlarged instance is drawn in the blueprint ink (surfaces in tint/16 with tint/48 borders, text and glyphs in ink, secondary texts at 60 %, layout boxes dashed) instead of the dark appearance, and every leader is straight (vertical above or below its target, horizontal beside it). forms-spec.plugin.js with ANATOMY_ONLY.

Options as properties (user: designers should add options without detaching): radio-group-options.plugin.js renamed Radio 1–3 to Option 1–3, added Option 4–8 (copies of Option 3), exposed the eight options and bound options 3 to 8 to the new booleans Show option 3 … Show option 8 (3 on by default). Checked: an option’s selection and label survive a change of Size.
